newsitem.title: USA: Glickman to lead U.S. group at World Food Summit.
newsitem.headline: Glickman to lead U.S. group at World Food Summit.

text.p: Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman will lead the U.S. delegation at the World Food Summit in Rome November 13-17, the USDA said Friday.

Glickman said that the United States will continue to promote self-reliance at the United Nations-sponsored event, and will assure countries that the United States will provide support to those nations that take steps to be more self sufficient.

The World Food Summit is being convened by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) of the United Nations. FAO is seeking a renewed commitment from world leaders to eradicate hunger and malnutrition and achieve food security through government policies and actions.
The interagency U.S. delegation will include senior officials from the departments of State, Commerce, Agriculture and the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative.
Ten private sector advisors will also attend the summit.
